description: Source code for jemalloc's thread cache (tcache) management, including functions for allocation, flushing, association with arenas, and thread cleanup.

methods.name: tcache_salloc
methods.description: Returns the size of the allocation pointed to by ptr using arena_salloc.

methods.name: tcache_event_hard
methods.description: Performs a hard event on the tcache, flushing bins based on watermarks.

methods.name: tcache_alloc_small_hard
methods.description: Allocates a small object from the tcache, filling the bin if necessary.

methods.name: tcache_bin_flush_small
methods.description: Flushes small bin objects back to the arena, updating stats.

methods.name: tcache_bin_flush_large
methods.description: Flushes large bin objects back to the arena, updating stats.

methods.name: tcache_arena_associate
methods.description: Associates a tcache with an arena, linking it into the arena's list.

methods.name: tcache_arena_dissociate
methods.description: Dissociates a tcache from its arena, updating stats and unlinking.

methods.name: tcache_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new tcache for a given arena.

methods.name: tcache_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a tcache, flushing bins and freeing associated memory.

methods.name: tcache_thread_cleanup
methods.description: Per-thread cleanup function for tcache, handling destruction or reinitialization.

methods.name: tcache_stats_merge
methods.description: Merges tcache statistics into the associated arena's stats.

methods.name: tcache_boot0
methods.description: Initializes tcache configuration parameters based on arena max class.

methods.name: tcache_boot1
methods.description: Completes tcache bootstrap, initializing thread-specific data.
